premises.text: Hiring talented new grads is valuable because they bring energy and hard work at lower cost, lifting the bottom line
premises.evidence_span: Young and talented students bring a lot of energy and hard work to a company, and they cost a lot less

premises.text: Relationships, not famous brand alone, determine whether great students accept offers
premises.evidence_span: He had known a couple of the people there and had built a relationship with them and they convinced him to come over there

premises.text: Traditional networking-based recruiting fails for students who are new to the workforce and poorly connected
premises.evidence_span: you can't rely on networking and referrals because students usually are not well connected and are new to the workforce

premises.text: Campus events create many first meetings, but students remain in the hiring pipeline for years afterward
premises.evidence_span: schools provide several avenues to meet lots of students at once, from career fairs to information sessions

premises.text: Meritful is an SRM that helps recruiting teams sustain multi-year student relationships via ambassadors, challenges, and project feedback
premises.evidence_span: help companies make the most out of this long cycle by creating a relationship with students

premises.text: The product is free for students and priced as a monthly company subscription
premises.evidence_span: always free for students and is available at a monthly subscription to companies

domains.name: Why student hiring and relationships matter

value.text: Growing companies hire the best students by building relationships with them
value.evidence_span: If you want to hire the best students, you need to build a relationship with them
